column2: What's past is dead. (let bygones be bygones)
Every delay has some good in it.
Choose the neighbour before the house.
Whoever does the sums alone always has some left over. (one-sided thinking)
Your brother is your brother, don't let a friend fool you.

column1: اللي ما عندو كبير يشريلو كبير.
column2: Whoever has no elder should buy one. (get wise advice)
Measure before you dive. (think before acting)

column1: ما يحس بالجمرة غير اللي كواتو.
column2: Only the one burned by the ember feels it.
The one you thought was Moses turns out to be Pharaoh. (appearances deceive)

column1: يا المزوّق من برا، واش حالك من داخل؟
column2: You who are decorated outside, how are you inside?
The eye doesn't rise above the eyebrow. (respect your elders)

column1: حوت ياكل حوت، وقليل الجهد يموت.
column2: Fish eat fish, and the weak die. (the strong eat the weak)
Patience is the key to relief.
Whoever doesn't know your value wastes you.
Every sheep hangs by its own leg. (everyone answers for themselves)
Get it into your head. / Remember it.
God will bring good things. (things will work out)
Whoever wants to do it, does it.
The axe fell on him. (he got caught / it fell on him)
He acted like he didn't know. / He played dumb.
Boss. (friendly way to address a man)
Don't rack your brain over it.

column1: ما تدخلش في واش ما يعنيكش.
column2: Don't meddle in what doesn't concern you.
Please. / Thank you. (literally: may God keep you)
Thank you. (literally: may He give you health)
